title: Dependencies
intro: Every dependency of the plan: the successor waits for the predecessor. The ones that do not hold are listed first and only warn; nothing moves. The owners of the successor's project, or an administrator, can add a dependency here, and change its type and lag or delete it in its row.

add.successorProjectHint: The project that waits. Only projects you can manage are listed.
add.successorHint: The milestone of that project that waits.
